attempts.summary: Built a 3-node MariaDB Galera cluster (node1-3) on AlmaLinux 9 from scratch (no prior MariaDB existed on any node), seeded it with an appdb.orders table and data, then expanded to 4 members by adding node4, which SST'd the existing data via rsync, joined as a Synced member, and accepted a write that replicated back to node1-3. Completed the mandatory restart-evidence protocol on all four nodes sequentially, each showing a changed boot_id and full cluster/data recovery (size=4, Primary, Synced, all rows intact) before the next node was restarted.
